summary: TechCreate Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing board and committee composition changes. Effective May 31, 2026, Independent Director Ling Wee Seng stepped down; Masayuki Tagai became Compensation Committee Chairman, CTO Lau Kok Fong was appointed Executive Director, and James Earle Northey and Weiyee In joined the Audit Committee. No shareholder vote, advisor, or compensation terms were disclosed. The changes appear orderly, not forced. This is a routine governance reshuffle; no special situation is present. What to watch: any subsequent departures or strategic shifts tied to the new board composition.
